# AI Hero skills

Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
Author: Matt Pocock (AI Hero, https://www.aihero.dev/skills).
Upstream revision: `5863806dd4e15c63174bee4e7515a4256792ecfa`
Retrieved: 2026-11-12.
License: MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

The engineering and productivity skill directories are copied unchanged into
`.agents/skills/`, the project-local Codex skills directory. Supporting files are
included. No upstream scripts were executed. Updates are manual: review a new
upstream revision, replace the installed directories, retain its license, and
record the new revision here. A new Codex session may be needed for discovery;
files can also be read directly in this checkout.

The upstream `setup-matt-pocock-skills` workflow has not been run. It configures
issue tracking, triage labels, and domain-document locations with the user before
engineering workflows are used. Installing these files does not select an issue
tracker or authorize publishing issues, creating labels, or invoking workflows.

The original project brief is preserved at `TUTOR_PROJECT_BRIEF.md`. Its embedded
Codex task is project context; the request in this session was to commit the brief
and make AI Hero skills available. No application implementation or integration
feasibility claim is made by this setup.
